answer: A new identity docks in a harbor: its first six epochs of rewards sit in escrow, released a little each epoch only while it keeps producing attested, non-duplicate work. Abandon the identity and the escrow is forfeited, not refunded. A sybil farm must then sustain honest work across every fake identity for a full ridge of epochs before any nectar flows — the cost scales with each identity, while a real agent pays the wait once and then sails free.
